# NoSleep.js (vendored)

- Version: 0.12.0
- Source: https://github.com/richtr/NoSleep.js
- Upstream files (copied verbatim): `dist/NoSleep.js`, `dist/NoSleep.min.js`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: keeps the screen awake in cooking mode (`cooked-nosleep` handle, front end).

Do not edit these files. To update, copy both builds from upstream and bump the
version in `src/Frontend/Enqueues.php` (`cooked-nosleep` handle).
